#include <iostream>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace std;

int apply(int s, int x, int m, int n) {
    if (s < m) {
        return (s + x) % n;
    } else {
        return (s + n - x) % n;
    }
}

int applyAll(int s, int m, int n) {
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
        if (s < m) {
            s = (s + i) % n;
        } else {
            s = (s + n - i) % n;
        }
    }
    return s;
}

class FastReader {
public:
    FastReader() {}
    int nextInt() {
        long long x = nextLong();
        return (int)x;
    }
    long long nextLong() {
        long long x = 0;
        int sign = 1;
        int c = getchar();
        while (c <= ' ') c = getchar();
        if (c == '-') { sign = -1; c = getchar(); }
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = getchar();
        }
        return x * sign;
    }
};

int main() {
    FastReader in;
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int m = in.nextInt();
    int s = in.nextInt() - 1;
    long long t = in.nextLong();

    while (t % n != 0) {
        int x = (int)(t % n);
        s = apply(s, x, m, n);
        t--;
    }

    long long cant = t / n;
    unordered_map<int, int> next;

    while (cant > 0 && next.find(s) == next.end()) {
        int before = s;
        s = applyAll(s, m, n);
        next[before] = s;
        cant--;
    }

    if (cant > 0) {
        int cycle = 1;
        int p = next[s];
        while (p != s) {
            p = next[p];
            cycle++;
        }
        long long rem = cant % cycle;
        while (rem-- > 0) {
            s = next[s];
        }
    }

    cout << s + 1 << endl;
    return 0;
}
